title: 第73章 房东涨房租
content_zh:
第73章 房东涨房租-《重生80，分家后带妻女吃香喝辣》

上一章

存书签

下一章

林国栋灰溜溜地站起来，走了。

走到院门口，回头看了一眼灶房的方向，咽了口口水。

那鸡汤的香味，飘了半条胡同。

他恨得牙痒痒。

以前那个任人拿捏的老二，真的死了。

现在这个林国强，心硬得像块石头。

可他又不得不承认。

这个心硬的林国强，日子过得比谁都好。

端午节那天，林国强起了个大早。

门上插了艾草，灶房里煮了粽子。

林静手腕上系着五彩线，满院子跑。

赵素梅包了两种粽子，红枣的和豆沙的。

林国强炖了只老母鸡，又做了条红烧鱼。

一家四口围坐着，过了个安稳的端午节。

赵素梅看着桌上的菜，忽然说：“国强，你说老宅那边，今天吃啥？”

林国强夹了块鸡肉：“管他们吃啥。”

赵素梅不问了。

她也就是随口一说。

她感觉现在的日子过得很舒坦，不想考虑太多人。

农忙一过，镇上的集市又热闹起来。

林国强的小吃店和供销社的卤味柜台，生意比麦收前更好了。

天热了，凉拌小菜卖得飞快。

卤味切好了用油纸包着，顾客拎回家就能下酒。

赵志军每天蹬着三轮车来回送货，晒得黑了一圈，但精神头十足。

林国强给他买了顶草帽，又给他加了五块钱降温费。

赵志军推辞不要，被林国强一句“让你拿着就拿着”堵了回去。

这天下午，林国强正在后厨配卤料，赵素梅从前头进来。

“国强，马主任来了。”

马主任大名叫马德福，是供销社的副主任，也是小吃店这间门面的房东。

当初林国强租这房子，可没少跟他说好话。

马德福五十来岁，胖墩墩的，穿着一件灰色短袖衬衫，手里摇着蒲扇。

进门先四下打量了一圈，目光在后厨那几口冒着热气的卤锅上停了停。

“马主任，什么风把您吹来了？”林国强擦了擦手，递上一根烟。

马德福接过烟，点上，吸了一口。

“林老板，生意不错啊。”

“托您的福，凑合。”

Lin Guodong stood up dejectedly and left.

When he walked to the entrance of the courtyard, he looked back in the direction of the kitchen and swallowed.

The aroma of chicken soup spread half way through the alley.

His teeth itched with hatred.

The second child who used to be at the mercy of others is really dead.

Now Lin Guoqiang's heart is as hard as a stone.

But he had to admit it.

This hard-hearted Lin Guoqiang lives a better life than anyone else.

On the day of the Dragon Boat Festival, Lin Guoqiang got up early.

Wormwood was planted on the door, and rice dumplings were cooked in the kitchen.

Lin Jing ran around the yard with colorful threads tied around her wrists.

Zhao Sumei made two kinds of rice dumplings, one with red dates and one with bean paste.

Lin Guoqiang stewed an old hen and made braised fish.

The family of four sat around and had a peaceful Dragon Boat Festival.

Zhao Sumei looked at the dishes on the table and suddenly said: "Guoqiang, what do you think we are eating today at the old house?"

Lin Guoqiang picked up a piece of chicken and said, "I don't care what they eat."

Zhao Sumei stopped asking.

She just said it casually.

She feels that her life is very comfortable now and she doesn't want to think about too many people.

After the busy farming season, the market in the town became lively again.

Lin Guoqiang's snack bar and supply and marketing cooperative's braised food counter are doing better than before the wheat harvest.

The weather is hot, and the cold side dishes are selling out quickly.

The braised meat is cut and wrapped in oil paper, so customers can take it home and drink it.

Zhao Zhijun rides a tricycle back and forth to deliver goods every day. He is tanned but full of energy.

Lin Guoqiang bought him a straw hat and added five yuan to him for cooling.

Zhao Zhijun refused, but was blocked by Lin Guoqiang who said, "Take it as long as you are told."

That afternoon, Lin Guoqiang was preparing marinade in the back kitchen when Zhao Sumei came in from the front.

"Guoqiang, Director Ma is here."

Director Ma's real name is Ma Defu, he is the deputy director of the supply and marketing cooperative and the landlord of the snack bar.

When Lin Guoqiang rented this house, he always said nice things to him.

Madford is in his fifties, chubby, wearing a gray short-sleeved shirt and holding a cattail leaf fan in his hand.

After entering the door, I looked around for a moment, and my eyes paused on the steaming braised pots in the back kitchen.

"Director Ma, what brought you here?" Lin Guoqiang wiped his hands and handed over a cigarette.

Madford took the cigarette, lit it, and took a puff.

"Boss Lin, business is good."

"Thanks to you, I'll make do."
